sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

Thank you for your offer and for sharing the background to your cost calculation. Please send the detailed cost breakdown in XLSX format so we can review its individual elements together. We would also welcome a proposal linking a longer contract term and agreed volumes to improved pricing and payment terms.

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.79, payment_days 14, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.84, payment_days 60, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.81, payment_days 30, contract_months 36). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We offer a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. We appreciate your confirmation of a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. 

As an alternative, based on this 36-month commitment and maintaining 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €4.88 per unit, with a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Our team will address your request for the detailed cost breakdown separately. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

Thank you for revising your offer and clearly outlining the payment-term alternatives. We propose building on the longer-term volume agreement you have outlined, considering pricing and payment terms together as a package to keep the renewal straightforward.

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.88, payment_days 90, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.8, payment_days 14, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.85, payment_days 60, contract_months 36). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your updated term sheets and appreciate your flexibility regarding payment terms.

Our main proposal features a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Building on your option for a 14-day payment term and the 36-month volume commitment, we can offer a price of €4.87 per unit with a price of €4.87 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This adjustment reflects the value of the accelerated payment schedule while maintaining our high service standards.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

Thank you for revising your offer and clarifying how payment terms and a binding volume commitment affect your pricing. We suggest building on the longer-term agreement by considering volume, price and payment terms together as a straightforward renewal package.

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.85, payment_days 14, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.9, payment_days 60, contract_months 36). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have carefully reviewed your latest proposal regarding the 14-day payment term. As a valued partner, we always strive to provide you with the best support from our extensive range and service portfolio.

Regarding our Angebot, our current offer is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative, we must maintain our price of €4.87 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months for the 36-month volume commitment with 14-day payment terms. Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, and our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
